title: Order-token 'Reference interne' <li> wrongly gated to DELIVERY-only — hides the token on the exact KIOSK/online/takeaway orders that carry it
proof: W3.6 added `v-if="displayedToken && order.order_type === enums.orderTypeEnum.DELIVERY"` (PosOrderShowComponent.vue:63). The token's own authoritative in-file comment (WT-D-R1-07, line 620) states: 'Token is an internal kiosk/online reference, NOT the order number.' Backend assigns orders.token generically from the request payload across non-delivery flows (OrderService.php:779 POS-create `'token' => $request->token`; OrderService.php:2497-2510 tokenCreate sets token on ANY order). It is NOT a delivery-specific field — delivery_time IS (correctly hidden), token is not. Read-only SELECT on the served e2e clone (foodking_dash_e2e, the DB behind :8769) proves the inversion: order_type=10 TAKEAWAY 2098 rows / 2030 with token; order_type=25 KIOSK 2/2 with token; order_type=5 DELIVERY 1 row / 0 tokens. So the v-if now SHOWS the token only for the one order class that never has one, and HIDES it for the ~2032 orders that do.
reproduction: 1) Read PosOrderShowComponent.vue:63 (new v-if) and :620-636 (displayedToken reads this.order.token). 2) `mysql foodking_dash_e2e -e "SELECT order_type, COUNT(*), SUM(token IS NOT NULL AND token<>'') FROM orders GROUP BY order_type"` => TAKEAWAY(10)=2030 tokens, KIOSK(25)=2 tokens, DELIVERY(5)=0 tokens. 3) Open any takeaway/kiosk POS order detail at :8769 -> the 'Reference interne' line is now suppressed despite a present token.
remediation: Gate the token <li> on `displayedToken` alone (its pre-existing condition), NOT on order_type===DELIVERY. The displayedToken computed already de-noises fixture tokens. If the intent was only to hide it from the delivery card context, the gate is exactly backwards for this internal-reference field. (Display-only; no NF525/frozen impact.)

title: SLA <24h actionable vs >=24h old bucketing — time math correct
proof: actionableAlerts filters `Number(a.time_preparing) < 1440`; oldAlerts `>= 1440`. Backend source proven to be MINUTES: app/Services/DashboardService.php:501 `'time_preparing' => (int) $startedAt->diffInMinutes($now)` — so 1440 == 24h exactly. The 15-min floor is backend-enforced (DashboardService.php:508 `->filter(fn($a)=>$a['_started_at']->lt($timeLimit))`), so the single <1440 cut is sufficient. NaN-safe: `Number(x)||0` coerces missing/NaN to 0 (lands in actionable as 0-min). Boundary: an alert at exactly 1440 min lands in oldAlerts (>= ), a defensible '24h is old' choice. The badge/ping/empty-state all keyed on actionableAlerts; old line is `v-if=!hasError && oldAlerts.length>0`, never inflates the badge. Compiled into served app.js (actionableAlerts x5, sla-alerts-old x1).
reproduction: grep -n time_preparing app/Services/DashboardService.php => :501 diffInMinutes; formatWait(minutes) at SlaAlertsComponent.vue:120 treats it as minutes (m/60 -> hours).
remediation: None. Minor cosmetic redundancy (backend already sorts oldest-first; FE re-sorts DESC) — harmless.

proof: (a) Link target name 'admin.transactions.list' EXISTS: resources/js/router/modules/transactionRoutes.js:10. (b) localizedStatus whitelist {open,closed,reconciled} fully covers all real ZReport.status values: the column is `string('status',16)->default('open') // open|closed` (migration 2026_04_22_000003_create_z_reports_table.php:57) and the model defines ONLY STATUS_OPEN='open'/STATUS_CLOSED='closed' (ZReport.php:15-16). remediation: Optional: drop the dead 'reconciled' key for clarity. Not a defect.

title: First-paint '...' loading guard — no permanent spinner, no data suppression
proof: `loaded:false` -> cards render '…'. fetchData().finally() sets `loaded=true` (RealtimeReportComponent.vue:64). .finally() runs on BOTH resolve and reject, so a failed first poll still lifts the placeholder (then hasError->'—'). Success path still assigns `this.report = res.data.data` (line ~52) — real data not suppressed. Ternary order `!loaded ? '…' : (hasError ? '—' : value)` is correct. No permanent-spinner path exists.
reproduction: sed -n '50,72p' RealtimeReportComponent.vue: .then assigns report; .finally sets loaded=true unconditionally.
